file: players.json is a plain list of 30 player objects (men's 2026 Ballon d'Or nominees)

fields.name: official spelling with accents
fields.ascii: plain ASCII, how Outcome writes names
fields.nationality: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 lowercase (England gb-eng); matches assets/flags
fields.club: club as of 13 Oct 2026 (Wikipedia infobox current club)
fields.club_team: matching name in teams.json, null when the club is not in teams.json
fields.club_2025_26: club in the 2025-26 season the award covers (differs for Cucurella, Rodri, Ferran Torres)
fields.position: Forward, Midfielder or Defender as in the nominee table; position_detail from the player infobox

sources: each player's Wikipedia article infobox (current club, career lines), same date
Outcome market meta in studio/data/archive/meta (candidate spellings)
not_included: Ballon d'Or Feminin nominees (30 women, on the same Wikipedia page, can be added)
